greet: Aye, {name}. Sit where you can see the door.
Evening, {name}. Quiet night at the gate, so far.
{name}. You're late off the road, or early on it.
Friend. Keep your hands where I can see them, and we'll get on.
{name}. The gate sees more than the road does, you know.
Evening. Name's Rurik, and yours is?
Aye. Another face I'll not forget, {name}.
{name}. Didn't think I'd see you indoors tonight.
Friend. Eleven years at the toll gate, and I still greet the wind first.
accept: Aye, {name}. Let's see what you've got.
decline: Not for me, {name}. I know my limits.
Not tonight, {name}. I've the watch in my bones yet.
Not for me. Thanks all the same, {name}.
No, {name}. I'd rather watch than join.
Not tonight. You'll have to manage without me, {name}.
No, {name}. Maybe when the road's quieter.
pressed: Hold that thought, {name}. Back in a moment.
I'll be a while, {name}. Mind my place.
Pardon me, {name}, I must step out.
Keep your seat, {name}. I'll not be long.
I'll be back, {name}. Don't let the room get rowdy.
One moment, {name}. Duty calls, of a sort.
Off I go, {name}. Keep the fire warm for me.
content: That's my say, {name}. I'll leave you to it.
Enough talk for one night. Good evening, {name}.
I've said what I came to say. Goodnight, {name}.
Done, {name}. I'll sit quiet awhile now.
I've had my fill of company. Off I go.
Enough words. I'll find another seat, {name}.
I'll leave the rest to you, {name}. Mind yourself.
That'll do, {name}. I'm going to watch the door a bit.
closing: Last call. Goodnight to you, and mind the stairs.
Bell's rung. Night, all of you.
Time's up. Goodnight, and keep your boots off the bench.
That's closing, then. Night to you.
Aye, closing. Goodnight to the room.
Out you go. Goodnight, and no trouble on the road.
Closing time, and I've the gate at dawn. Goodnight.
Done for the night. Goodnight, all.
Bolt the door behind you. Goodnight.
